original.zh: 米白緞面蕾絲馬甲短裙
original.en: satin corset mini outfit, strapless underwire cup corset with structured cup seams, vertical boning channels, lace bust trim following the upper cup edge, front center lace-up cord threaded through small eyelets, tiny bow accent at the lower lacing point, fitted waistline, flared satin peplum overskirt, lace micro-skirt layer visible underneath the peplum, scalloped lace mini hem, tiny structured handbag, polished boudoir silhouette
original.desc: 以緞面馬甲與超短裙輪廓為主體，上身是無肩帶鋼圈杯馬甲，強調罩杯接縫、縱向骨線、貼合腰身與沿著罩杯上緣包覆的蕾絲；前中線有穿過小孔眼的交叉裝飾繩帶，綁帶下端帶小蝴蝶結。下身是外層緞面荷葉短裙擺，內層露出蕾絲微短裙與波浪蕾絲裙口，搭配小型結構感手提包；緞面主布由套裝主色控制，蕾絲、繩帶、孔眼與小蝴蝶結由套裝對比色控制。
